name: number-flow-trading
title: Live Price Ticker
description: A stock-style price display for NVDA showing a large dollar figure and a rounded badge with an arrow and percent change. A Shuffle button cycles sample prices, rolling the digits and turning the arrow for losses.
use: A dashboard or marketing page wants a compact animated price readout with a direction indicator.
avoid: The shuffle samples are three hardcoded prices, so a real feed needs rewiring and the Shuffle control removed.
a11y: Shuffle is a real button with visible text, but price changes are visual only and the arrow direction has no text alternative. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large white dollar amount sits on black beneath a small NVDA · Nasdaq caption. Beside the price is a small rounded pill in green or red holding a tiny arrow and a percentage, with a dark Shuffle pill centred below.
behaves: Pressing Shuffle swaps to another sample price: the dollar digits roll vertically to the new value, the percent badge updates colour, and its arrow spins to point down when the change is negative.
customise: PriceWithDiff takes a value and diff as props, while the shuffle demo's three sample prices and the ticker caption live in the source.
weight: light: One price, one badge and a small shuffle button with short animations.
